verdict.rationale: A government digital-administration portal could plausibly offer AI-generated guidance or insights on a user's file, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only front-door probes: a roughly 3 KB JavaScript shell on the ANEF host and a Cloudflare challenge on the ministry site. Neither mentions any AI-generated insights or suggestions, so there is no evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
